rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for breaking waves along the shore.

example.english: The surf by the shore is really big.
example.jyutping: hoi2 bin1 di1 long6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for browsing the Internet.

example.english: I surf the Internet and watch videos all the time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 soeng5 mong5 tai2 pin2

rows.note: Use this specifically for surfing television channels by changing from one channel to another.

example.english: I surf TV channels to find something worth watching.
example.traditional: 我不斷轉台，睇下有冇啱睇嘅節目。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bat1 dyun6 zyun2 toi4 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 ngaam1 tai2 ge3 zit3 muk6

rows.note: Use this for taking part in surfing or riding waves on a surfboard.

example.english: They surf in Hawaii during the holidays.
example.traditional: 佢放假去夏威夷玩滑浪。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fong3 gaa3 heoi3 haa6 wai1 ji4 waan2 waat6 long6

rows.note: Use this for surfing as a sport or a surfing session, rather than for the waves themselves.

example.english: We went to surf at Big Wave Bay this morning.
example.traditional: 我哋朝早去大浪灣滑浪。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 daai6 long6 waan1 waat6 long4
